title: Replace generic cosmetics with Gorilla Tag themed items

requirements.text: Replace the existing cosmetic items catalog with approximately 50 Gorilla Tag themed cosmetics including finger painter, AA badge, illustrator badge, stick, forest guide, and other iconic items from the game

quotes: Make the cosmetics not beauty items make them gorilla tag cosmetics such as finger painter, AA badge ,illustrator badge ,Stick, Forrest guide and much more about fifty Og them

acceptanceCriteria: Backend contains approximately 50 Gorilla Tag themed cosmetic items
Items include finger painter, AA badge, illustrator badge, stick, and forest guide
Each item maintains the existing £10 price point
All items have appropriate names reflecting Gorilla Tag cosmetics

requirements.text: Update the frontend shop interface to display the new Gorilla Tag themed cosmetics with appropriate styling and imagery
acceptanceCriteria: Shop interface displays all approximately 50 Gorilla Tag cosmetic items
Each item card shows the Gorilla Tag themed name
Visual presentation is consistent with existing shop layout
Items maintain purchase functionality and owned status indicators

constraints: Maintain the existing £10 price point for all cosmetic items
Preserve the purchase system, balance tracking, and owned items functionality
Keep the secret admin code (2807) and automatic income system unchanged
nonGoals: Adding moderation panel or item management interface
Adding ability to dynamically add or delete items
